prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore` to restore deleted episodes with their cuts at their prior order and shift following episodes down, added an Undo action to the delete toast on the Episodes page in both English and Korean, and added backend tests.

+def duplicate_episode(

+    existing = _ordered_project_episodes(session, episode.project_id)

+
+    new_episode = Episode(
+        project_id=episode.project_id,
+        title=f"{episode.title} (Copy)",
+        story_summary=episode.story_summary,
+        episode_order=orig_index + 2,
+        status="ready" if episode.status == "generating" else episode.status,
+        background_info=episode.background_info,
+        character_outfits=copy.deepcopy(episode.character_outfits) if episode.character_outfits is not None else {},
+        character_reference_board_urls=(
+            list(episode.character_reference_board_urls) if episode.character_reference_board_urls else []
+        ),
+    )
+    session.add(new_episode)
+    session.flush()
+
+    ordered = existing[: orig_index + 1] + [new_episode] + existing[orig_index + 1 :]
+    _resequence_episodes(session, ordered)
+
+    source_cuts = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut)
+        .where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode.id)

+    first_cut_image_url = None

+            location=cut.location,
+            time_of_day=cut.time_of_day,
+            transition_ref=cut.transition_ref,
+            selected_layout=cut.selected_layout,
+            aspect_ratio=cut.aspect_ratio,
+            image_path=cut.image_path,
+            image_asset_id=cut.image_asset_id,

+            dialogues=copy.deepcopy(cut.dialogues) if cut.dialogues is not None else [],
+            appearing_characters=copy.deepcopy(cut.appearing_characters) if cut.appearing_characters is not None else [],

+        session.add(copied_cut)
+        if first_cut_image_url is None and copied_cut.image_path:

+
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(new_episode)

+@router.post("/{episode_id}/restore", response_model=EpisodeOut)

+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Restore a deleted episode with its cuts at its previous place.
+    """
+    episode = _require_episode_workspace_member(
+        session, episode_id, current_user_id, include_deleted=True
+    )
+    if episode.deleted_at is None:
+        raise AppException(
+            error_code=ErrorCode.VALIDATION_INVALID_INPUT,
+            detail="Episode is not deleted",
+        )
+
+    existing = _ordered_project_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+    target_order = episode.episode_order or (len(existing) + 1)
+    insert_at = max(0, min(target_order - 1, len(existing)))
+
+    episode.deleted_at = None
+    session.add(episode)
+    session.flush()
+
+    ordered = existing[:insert_at] + [episode] + existing[insert_at:]
+    _resequence_episodes(session, ordered)
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(episode)
+
+    first_cut = session.exec(
+        select(StoryCut)
+        .where(StoryCut.episode_id == episode.id)
+        .where(StoryCut.image_path != None)
+        .order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)
+        .limit(1)
+    ).first()
+    first_cut_image_url = _format_first_cut_image_url(first_cut.image_path if first_cut else None)
+
+    return _serialize_episode(episode, first_cut_image_url)

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Episode, StoryCut, Workspace, WorkspaceMember, User
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="Opening scene"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_inserts_right_after_original_and_shifts_following(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1, summary="Summary one")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2, summary="Summary two")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3, summary="Summary three")
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        orig_ep1 = session.get(Episode, UUID(ep1["id"]))
+        orig_ep1.background_info = "Rainy bus stop at midnight"
+        orig_ep1.character_outfits = {"Minho": "Yellow raincoat"}
+        session.add(orig_ep1)
+
+        cut1 = StoryCut(
+            episode_id=UUID(ep1["id"]),
+            cut_order=1,
+            script="Minho waits in the rain.",
+            location="Bus Stop",
+            time_of_day="Night",
+            transition_ref="Fade in",
+            selected_layout="wide",
+            aspect_ratio="16:9",
+            image_path="cuts/orig/cut1.png",
+            status="completed",
+            dialogues=[{"speaker": "Minho", "text": "Where is the bus?"}],
+            appearing_characters=[{"id": "char-1", "name": "Minho"}],
+            refer_prev_cut=False,
+        )
+        cut2 = StoryCut(
+            episode_id=UUID(ep1["id"]),
+            cut_order=2,
+            script="Headlights appear.",
+            selected_layout="vertical",
+            aspect_ratio="9:16",
+            image_path="https://cdn.example.com/cut2.png",
+            status="completed",
+            dialogues=[{"speaker": "Driver", "text": "Last stop!"}],
+            appearing_characters=[{"id": "char-2", "name": "Driver"}],
+            refer_prev_cut=True,
+        )
+        session.add(cut1)
+        session.add(cut2)
+        session.commit()
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    dup = r.json()
+
+    assert dup["id"] != ep1["id"]
+    assert dup["project_id"] == project["id"]
+    assert dup["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert dup["title"] != ep1["title"]
+    assert ep1["title"] in dup["title"]
+    assert "copy" in dup["title"].lower()
+    assert dup["story_summary"] == "Summary one"
+    assert dup["background_info"] == "Rainy bus stop at midnight"
+    assert dup["character_outfits"] == {"Minho": "Yellow raincoat"}
+    assert dup["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/orig/cut1.png")
+
+    # Copy is right after original; following episodes shifted down by 1; numbered 1, 2, 3, 4
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in ep_list] == [ep1["id"], dup["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in ep_list] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Cuts copied in same order with all fields
+    orig_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep1['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    dup_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(dup_cuts) == 2
+    assert [c["id"] for c in dup_cuts] != [c["id"] for c in orig_cuts]
+
+    for orig_c, dup_c in zip(orig_cuts, dup_cuts):
+        assert dup_c["episode_id"] == dup["id"]
+        assert dup_c["cut_order"] == orig_c["cut_order"]
+        assert dup_c["script"] == orig_c["script"]
+        assert dup_c["dialogues"] == orig_c["dialogues"]
+        assert dup_c["selected_layout"] == orig_c["selected_layout"]
+        assert dup_c["aspect_ratio"] == orig_c["aspect_ratio"]
+        assert dup_c["appearing_characters"] == orig_c["appearing_characters"]
+        assert dup_c["image_path"] == orig_c["image_path"]
+        assert dup_c["refer_prev_cut"] == orig_c["refer_prev_cut"]
+
+    # Duplicating the last episode appends at the end without gaps
+    r_last = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r_last.status_code == 200, r_last.text
+    dup_last = r_last.json()
+    assert dup_last["episode_order"] == 5
+
+    ep_list_after = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in ep_list_after] == [ep1["id"], dup["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"], dup_last["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in ep_list_after] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
+
+
+def test_delete_episode_closes_gap_and_keeps_contiguous_numbering(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1)
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2)
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3)
+
+    # Delete middle episode
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in ep_list] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in ep_list] == [1, 2]
+
+    # Delete first episode
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in ep_list] == [ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in ep_list] == [1]
+
+    # Creating episodes with gaps or colliding orders normalizes to 1, 2, 3...
+    ep4 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 4", order=99)
+    ep5 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 5", order=1)
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in ep_list] == [ep5["id"], ep3["id"], ep4["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in ep_list] == [1, 2, 3]
+

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import WorkspaceMember, User
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title, order, summary=""):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_restore_deleted_episode_brings_back_cuts_and_shifts_following(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], "Ep 1", 1, "First")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], "Ep 2", 2, "Second")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], "Ep 3", 3, "Third")
+
+    cut1 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": ep2["id"],
+            "cut_order": 1,
+            "script": "Cut one script",
+            "selected_layout": "wide",
+            "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Wait!"}],
+            "appearing_characters": [{"id": "c1", "name": "Hero"}],
+            "image_path": "cuts/ep2/panel1.png",
+        },
+    ).json()
+    cut2 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=h,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": ep2["id"],
+            "cut_order": 2,
+            "script": "Cut two script",
+            "selected_layout": "single",
+            "aspect_ratio": "1:1",
+            "dialogues": [],
+            "appearing_characters": [],
+            "image_path": "https://cdn.example.com/panel2.png",
+        },
+    ).json()
+
+    # Delete ep2 -> ep3 moves to 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in ep_list] == [ep1["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in ep_list] == [1, 2]
+
+    # Restore ep2 -> returns at order 2, ep3 moves down to 3, cuts intact
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    restored = r.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == ep2["id"]
+    assert restored["title"] == "Ep 2"
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "Second"
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert restored["first_cut_image"].endswith("cuts/ep2/panel1.png")
+
+    ep_list_after = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in ep_list_after] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in ep_list_after] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    cuts_after = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [c["id"] for c in cuts_after] == [cut1["id"], cut2["id"]]
+    assert cuts_after[0]["script"] == "Cut one script"
+    assert cuts_after[0]["dialogues"] == [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Wait!"}]
+    assert cuts_after[1]["script"] == "Cut two script"
+
+
+def test_restore_first_episode_and_already_active_episode(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], "Ep 1", 1)
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], "Ep 2", 2)
+
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()[0]["id"] == ep2["id"]
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 1
+
+    ep_list = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in ep_list] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in ep_list] == [1, 2]
+
+    # Restoring an already-active episode is rejected cleanly without shifting
+    r_again = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r_again.status_code == 400
+
+
+def test_restore_episode_workspace_authorization_and_404(client):
+    owner_h = signup(client, email="owner@example.com")
+    outsider_h = signup(client, email="outsider@example.com")
+    member_h = signup(client, email="member@example.com")
+
+    project = _create_project(client, owner_h)
+    ep = _create_episode(client, owner_h, project["id"], "Secret Ep", 1)
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=owner_h).status_code == 204
+
+    # Unauthenticated -> 401
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
+
+    # Non-member -> 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=outsider_h).status_code == 404
+
+    # Unknown UUID -> 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/restore", headers=owner_h).status_code == 404
+
+    # Workspace member (non-owner) -> 200
+    owner_ws_id = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner_h).json()[0]["id"]
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        member_user = session.query(User).filter(User.email == "member@example.com").first()
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=UUID(owner_ws_id), user_id=member_user.id, role="member"))
+        session.commit()
+
+    r_member = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=member_h)
+    assert r_member.status_code == 200, r_member.text
+    assert r_member.json()["id"] == ep["id"]
